name: Facet
text:
**Decision:** Use a dark theme with high-contrast accents as the *only* theme for Excava’s interface.

This maximizes visibility and liveliness in low-light settings, matching the competitive analysis of Manus and Graphify. The trade-off is excluding users who prefer light themes, but dark themes reduce eye strain and align with the goal of speed and clarity. High-contrast accents ensure critical elements stand out instantly.

name: Pane
text: Pane: High-contrast dark mode hides subtle errors—like faint validation warnings—until users hover or click, breaking the "speed of our screen" rule. A manual theme toggle forces users to solve our problem for us; some won’t bother, others will default to light mode and lose the benefits entirely. Settle it with A/B testing: measure error rates and task completion time between a forced dark mode and a system-preference default.

name: Facet
text:
**Decision:** Add a persistent, one-click “high-contrast mode” toggle that defaults to dark but lets users instantly switch to a light theme when needed.

This keeps the dark theme as the primary choice—preserving visibility and liveliness for most users—while giving a clear escape hatch for edge cases like faint validation warnings. The trade-off is a slightly busier interface, but the toggle’s simplicity and permanence ensure users never get stuck solving our problem for us.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A one-click toggle still outsources the problem—users must *remember* to switch when errors appear, and the toggle itself clutters the interface, slowing "speed of our screen." Better: auto-switch to high-contrast light mode *only* when validation warnings appear, then revert. Settle it with a 5-user usability test—if anyone misses warnings in dark mode, we adopt the auto-switch.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Auto-switch to a high-contrast light theme *only* when validation warnings appear, then revert to dark mode—no toggle, no user action required.

Result: Errors stay visible without clutter or memory tax. Owned by Facet.
